about: Routing set for /writ, labeled from commands/writ.md ## Routing Rules before any run. Requests come from the maintainer's past Claude Code sessions in personal projects, lightly edited to remove client, company, and personal names. Label = the route the table implies; acceptable = a second route the table also supports, decided before the run.
labeled_by: orchestrating agent, 2026-10-24, from the routing table only
workspace: a small sample app with Writ installed by install.sh --platform claude from tag v0.44.0-rc.1, plus .writ/product/roadmap.md naming Phase 14; the requests' own projects are not present

items.request: How can I make this routine more autonomous? I still need to manually allow things.
